about: A vs-Computer game started through the board scan from a set-up position is copied with [SetUp "1"] [FEN] and numbered from that position's own move number and side, and Analyze and Review open it instead of failing at move 1. Graded by gate 97 (TC-PL-069a..c, White to move at 3; TC-R378, Black to move at 3 with the player Black) at kunal761 and 320x568. NOT COVERED: the play screen's own moves panel, which still numbers a set-up game from 1 (display only, named by #550 as not this job); Pass & Play and online games (online never starts from a set-up position); Kunal's own phone.

breaks.name: the-set-up-fen-is-not-written
breaks.why: pgnMovesFrom writes no [SetUp]/[FEN] tags, so the copy carries no start position and the review replays the moves from the initial position and fails at move 1 - the job's defect

breaks.name: moves-are-numbered-from-one
breaks.why: the FEN rides in but the copied moves are numbered from 1 ('1. Bc4') instead of the position's own move number

breaks.name: black-to-move-is-numbered-as-white
breaks.why: the side to move in the FEN is ignored, so a game from a Black-to-move position is copied as '3. Nf6 Qe2' - only the Black arm (TC-R378) can see it
